summary: First iteration testing of Sandhya Puri Sanyas Ashram MERN app. All 25 backend pytest tests passed (100%). All critical frontend flows verified via Playwright: home, hero, language switcher (Hindi/English/Sanskrit with nav staying English), donate mock flow, gallery grid + pagination + lightbox, contact form (captcha solved), admin login + all 8 dashboard tabs.
critical_code_review_comments: donate.js mock-mode check (line 12): isMock falls back to true when KEY_ID/SECRET are empty even if RAZORPAY_MODE=live — intentional but document this safety guard so admins don't think 'live' alone enables real payments.
auth.js login: no brute-force/rate limit and no lockout after N failures (playbook expects 5-fail lockout). Add simple in-memory or DB-backed lockout if security-critical.

auth.js login: token is returned in JSON body only; no httpOnly cookie. Frontend stores it client-side (visible in AuthContext). Consider httpOnly cookie + CORS credentials for stronger security if app moves to production.
CORS in server.js uses origin:'*' — fine for current open API, but if cookies are introduced later, switch to explicit origin list with credentials:true.
AdminDashboard.js (~350+ lines) and Donate.js (~360+ lines) are within limit but starting to grow; consider extracting AdminTabs* sub-components when feature set expands.
Express error handler returns err.message directly to client (server.js line 57) — fine for dev but in production, mask internal error details for 5xx responses.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed donations (mock + upi_manual) and a TEST_ contact submission; data persists in MongoDB. Hero/Activity/Gallery items created in CRUD tests are deleted within the same test. Cleanup of TEST_ donations/contact not implemented but data is identifiable by TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 25 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py pass against the MERN stack via the FastAPI proxy (server.py spawns node/server.js on 127.0.0.1:8002). Razorpay is in MOCK mode — create-order returns order_mock_<hex> and verify always succeeds with paymentStatus=mock_paid. Frontend testids are present on all interactive elements. Captcha on /contact is a simple arithmetic question rendered in the label text — use regex to solve. Language switcher: nav labels always stay English; only body content switches Hindi/English/Sanskrit.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
